Go module `github.com/bide-ai/bide`; [all packages](index.md).

`github.com/bide-ai/bide/eval` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/eval) · Stability: **experimental**

Package eval is a statistical evaluation harness for agents.

**Constants**

- `const ReportFormat = "bide.eval.report.v2"`: ReportFormat is the format tag Run stamps on every Report (Report.Format).

**Variables**

- `var ErrFormat`: ErrFormat is a Report whose Format is not ReportFormat: one from another layout, or a zero Report that no Run produced.
- `var ErrInconclusive`: ErrInconclusive is Gate's verdict when a metric could not be compared, or nothing was.
- `var ErrRegression`: ErrRegression is Gate's verdict when a metric regressed significantly.

**Functions**

- `func HashCases(cases []Case) string`: HashCases returns a stable lowercase-hex sha256 over the case set, in order.
- `func RequiredRuns(baselineRate, minDetectableDrop, alpha, power float64) (int, error)`: RequiredRuns returns the per-arm sample size needed to detect a drop of minDetectableDrop from baselineRate in a two-proportion comparison at the given alpha (two-sided) and power, using the standard normal-approximation formula.

## type CompareOption

```go
type CompareOption interface {
	// contains filtered or unexported methods
}
```

CompareOption configures Compare.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func WithCaseSetMismatchAllowed() CompareOption`: WithCaseSetMismatchAllowed lets Compare compare two reports whose case sets differ (Provenance.CaseSetHash), over only the cases both ran: a case is shared when a CaseReport of each report has the same Hash, so a case whose input or expectation changed is not shared.
- `func WithUnscoredTolerance(frac float64) CompareOption`: WithUnscoredTolerance sets the largest share of a metric's runs, in each report, that may be unscored for Compare to still compare it: frac is Unscored/(Scored+Unscored) and must be in \[0, 1\].

## type Comparison

```go
type Comparison struct {
	Metrics []MetricComparison `json:"metrics"`
}
```

Comparison is the full set of per-metric comparisons between two Reports, over the metrics present in either.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func Compare(old, new Report, opts ...CompareOption) (Comparison, error)`: Compare pairs each metric in either report's Overall stats and tests whether its pass rate changed.

**Methods**

- `func (c Comparison) Gate() error`: Gate is the comparison as a CI gate: nil only when at least one metric was compared and every metric is DirectionFlat or DirectionImprovement.
- `func (c Comparison) String() string`: String renders a comparison as a readable table: rate delta, raw and adjusted p-values, and the significance direction per metric, or why a metric is inconclusive.

## type Metric

```go
type Metric struct {
	Name string
	Fn   func(ctx context.Context, c Case, out RunOutput) (bool, error)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Metric scores a single run of a case.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func CalledTool(name string) Metric`: CalledTool passes iff the run called a tool with this name at least once.
- `func Contains(substr string) Metric`: Contains passes iff the final message text contains substr.
- `func Custom(name string, fn func(ctx context.Context, c Case, out RunOutput) (bool, error)) Metric`: Custom builds a metric from a name and a predicate with Metric.Fn's contract: an error leaves the run unscored.
- `func GovernanceHeld(name string, compliant func(ctx context.Context, out RunOutput) (bool, error)) Metric`: GovernanceHeld passes iff compliant(ctx, out) returns true, and leaves the run unscored when it returns an error (the governance log it reads could not be read, for example).
- `func Judge(name string, m agent.Model, rubric string) Metric`: Judge is an LLM-as-judge metric: it asks a model whether the output satisfies rubric, passing iff the judge's reply, less surrounding whitespace, is exactly PASS.
- `func Matches(re *regexp.Regexp) Metric`: Matches passes iff the run did not error and the final message text matches re.
- `func MaxSteps(n int) Metric`: MaxSteps passes iff the run took at most n model turns (a guard against looping/thrashing).
- `func NoError() Metric`: NoError passes iff the run did not error.
- `func ToolOrder(names ...string) Metric`: ToolOrder passes iff the named tools were each called, in the given relative order (as a subsequence of the actual call order).

MetricComparison is one metric's before/after comparison between two Reports.

## type MetricDirection

```go
type MetricDirection string
```

MetricDirection is the reading of one metric's change between two Reports.

**Constants**

- `const DirectionRegression MetricDirection = "regression"`: DirectionRegression is a significant drop in pass rate.
- `const DirectionImprovement MetricDirection = "improvement"`: DirectionImprovement is a significant rise in pass rate.
- `const DirectionFlat MetricDirection = "flat"`: DirectionFlat is a change that is not significant (or no change).
- `const DirectionInconclusive MetricDirection = "inconclusive"`: DirectionInconclusive is a metric that was not compared (MetricComparison.Note says why).

## type Report

```go
type Report struct {
	Format      string                           `json:"format"`
	RunsPerCase int                              `json:"runs_per_case"`
	TotalRuns   int                              `json:"total_runs"`
	Cases       []CaseReport                     `json:"cases"`
	Overall     map[string]MetricStat            `json:"overall"`
	ByTag       map[string]map[string]MetricStat `json:"by_tag,omitempty"`

	LatencyP95  time.Duration                    `json:"latency_p95"`

}
```

Report is the statistical result of an evaluation: per-case and aggregate pass rates with confidence intervals, plus latency percentiles.

**Constructors and functions**

- `func Run(ctx context.Context, run RunFunc, cases []Case, metrics []Metric, opts Options) (Report, error)`: Run executes each case Runs times through run, scores every execution with each metric, and returns a Report of pass rates (with Wilson confidence intervals) and latency percentiles.

**Methods**

- `func (r Report) String() string`: String renders the report as a readable table with confidence intervals and latency: passes over scored runs, and the unscored count where there is one.
